guidetextdraw._value:
PURPOSE OF THIS FORM

California State University, Fullerton (CSUF) offers access to AI-powered tools and services—such as TitanGPT, Adobe AI Assistant, and other educational AI platforms—to enhance learning and engagement. Students under the age of 18 must have parental or guardian consent to use these services.

This form provides important information about these services and requests your authorization for your child to access them. Use of campus AI services is voluntary.

DESCRIPTION OF AI SERVICES

Your child may be granted access to the following campus AI tools, subject to the terms and conditions associated with the use of each tool:

  • TitanGPT – A secure, university-hosted version of ChatGPT for academic and support use.
  • Adobe AI Assistant – A creative and academic tool integrated into Adobe platforms.
  • Other approved AI tools provided by CSUF to support learning, communication, and research.

These services allow students to interact with AI-powered systems to receive support, generate content, and learn more effectively. All use is governed by CSUF policies.

INFORMATION THAT MAY BE COLLECTED

When using AI tools, students may input:

  • Class-related prompts or questions
  • Coursework and project details
  • Feedback or reflections related to assignments

Students are instructed not to input sensitive personal information, such as:

  • Social security numbers
  • Health records
  • Financial information

BENEFITS AND RISKS

Benefits:

  • Enhanced academic support
  • Improved engagement and digital literacy
  • Access to tools aligned with real-world technologies

Risks:

  • AI-generated responses may sometimes be inaccurate or inappropriate
  • Interactions may be logged for quality, safety, and security assurance
  • Minimal data handling risks under CSUF's secure usage policies

PARENTAL/GUARDIAN CONSENT

By signing below, I acknowledge and agree to the following on behalf of my minor student listed below:

  • I have read and understand the information in this consent.
  • I authorize my child to access and use AI tools provided by CSUF.
  • I understand that all use is subject to university policies.
  • I may revoke this consent at any time by contacting [Insert Department Email or Phone Number] in writing.
